thread:
Alex: Quick sync request — we need a cross-functional roadmap sync next week to settle the priority dispute between Search infra optimizations and Conversations rollout. 30m preferred. Mon/Tue availability? :thinking:

Priya: Monday works for me in the afternoon. Can we have an agenda? I want a clear decision log item for priorities and owners. :memo:

Marta: Tue morning is better for Eng, but we can be flexible. Can we combine RFC review + quick triage? The RFC for convo rate-limits is linked here: https://redwood/repo/rfcs/conv-rate-limits (please read before).

Alex: Agenda draft — please react with :thumbsup: if ok or suggest edits:
```
1) 5m context + goals (Priya)
2) 10m RFC review (Marta)
3) 10m Priority decision (Search vs Conversations) — tradeoffs & metrics (Alex/Chris)
4) 5m Owners + next steps + decision log entry (Priya)
```

Chris: Can we make it 45m if we expect design back-and-forth? Some points need drawing out. Tue 10:00-11:00 PT open for me.

Sam: Heads up — infra oncall has a rollout at Tue 10:15. I can do Tue 9:00 or Tue 11:30. Otherwise Mon 2pm PT works.

Jia: Suggest adding a quick triage queue item: any regressions from recent quantized model deploys that change perf/cost assumptions. 2-3 slides max.

Priya: I'll own the agenda and write the decision template. Priya: Proposed times (vote): Mon 14:00 PT, Tue 09:00 PT, Tue 11:30 PT. Please react with :one:, :two:, :three:.

Marta: :two: for me. Will prep RFC highlights and 1 slide on perf impact.

Alex: :two: from me as well. I'll bring historical metrics for Search SLA impact.

Chris: :three: but can rearrange if majority picks :two:.

Sam: :one: but can do :two: if needed.

DevBot: Meeting created: "Roadmap sync — Search vs Conversations" Tue 09:00 PT — calendar invite sent to participants. Link: https://meet.redwood/roadmap-sync-1710001234 :calendar:

Priya: Thanks — I've added a pre-reads section in the invite and created a decision log stub: https://redwood/docs/decision-log/2024-03-search-vs-convo. Please add any notes before the meeting.

Alex: Quick ask — if you have data to influence the decision, drop it in the doc or ping me in thread. We'll use a lightweight vote during the meeting.

Jia: I'll add the quantized-deploy perf numbers and a 1-slide summary.

Marta: Will summarize RFC concerns and open questions.

Chris: Prep note: if Conversations needs more infra, we should list rollout gating metrics so product can see cost vs. user impact.

Priya: Perfect. See you all Tue 09:00 PT. If anything changes, update the invite. :white_check_mark:
file_notes: Cross-functional product/engineering sync scheduling thread; agenda ownership and decision log setup
